summary: Universal Health Services, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into the Eleventh Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement, establishing a Senior Secured Credit Facility. The amendment adds a $200 million incremental revolving credit facility, a $300 million incremental tranche A term loan, and a $400 million incremental delayed draw tranche A term loan. The loans mature on September 26, 2029, with scheduled quarterly amortization. JPMorgan Chase Bank serves as administrative agent. This is a routine debt refinancing/expansion, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event. What to watch: subsequent drawdowns or further amendments.
